question.prompt: \(\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF\), and their areas are \(9\text{ cm}^2\) and \(25\text{ cm}^2\), respectively. The altitude to a side of \(\triangle ABC\) is \(6\text{ cm}\). Find the altitude to the corresponding side of \(\triangle DEF\). (Unit: cm)

solutions.explanation: The area ratio is \(9:25\), so the similarity ratio is \(3:5\). The ratio of corresponding altitudes equals the similarity ratio: \(6/h=3/5\), giving \(h=10\).
solutions.title: Recover the altitude ratio from the areas
